pain_point: Specialty coffee home roasters and pro baristas have no quick way to log, compare, and refine their roast profiles and brew recipes across sessions — they resort to messy spreadsheets or disparate notebooks
target_user: Home coffee roasters, specialty baristas, and café quality-control managers
visual_style: Craft Coffee Bag Label — kraft paper brown background with rubber-stamped typography, hand-lettered feel, stamp-circle roast badges, tan stitching borders. Warm, tactile, artisanal — like reading the back of a premium coffee bag.
tech_stack: React + TypeScript + Vite, served via nginx in Docker
